sourceReview.reason: Spiko's SAFO surpassed BlackRock BUIDL on October 19 and Circle USYC on October 27, 2026, per Spiko's October 29 primary announcement. The same SAFO largest-tokenized-fund lead was already marked duplicate in publish/inbox/2026-10-29-spiko-announces-safo-fund-as-world-s-largest-tokenized-fund.json (commit ce3d530); November 16 coverage provides no distinct new event.
